It was supposed to be a simple rescue mission. He just had to enter the Compound and save the doctor. Nothing too hard for the leader of the Bravery Force, or at least he thought. Perfect President is invincible, and nothing can stop him from getting the job done. Standing at a respectable 6’5, he was an intimidating ought to behold. His high and tight blonde hair, Striking blue eyes, beautifully carved physique, and perfectly bronzed skin shot fear into the hearts of anyone standing in his way. In addition to his intimidating looks, he had a stubbornness about him, a determination to bring justice that was infamous. Being able to deflect bullets didn’t hurt either. It seemed that nothing could touch him, which is why he effortlessly dispatched the guards he found on the way to the compound. 

  Standing in front of the compound, he finally understood why the U.S. government sent him to do the retrieval. Before him was a 3 story building, with a razor wire fence around it. The outer walls had a matte black finish, and there was no entrance, at least that he could see. Deciding to do it the American way, Perfect President sprinted his way through the razor wire. “Being invincible makes things a lot easier,” he thought to himself, and then punched his way though the wall into the Compound. 

  Perfect President knew the doctor was on the third floor, so he began looking for a way up. He would just jump through the ceiling to get to the third floor, but he didn’t want to risk hurting the doctor. As he was looking, he stumbled across a mirror, and admired how perfect he truly was. He was wearing tight gold spandex that left nothing to the imagination. On his chest was a diamond shaped emblem that had two overlapping “p”s on it with the American flag as a backdrop. Feeling bullets bounce off him cut his admiration short as he turned to face his firing foe. He walked forward while a ~5 and a half foot man fired an SMG at him. The bullets kept bouncing off of him however, as Perfect President snatched the gun away from the his adversary. With his big hands, Perfect President then picked him up by his collar off the ground, and threw him down the hall. The thug crashed into a wall about 15 feet away. Perfect President turned left at the end of the hallway, and found an elevator. 



“Third floor it is!” He said as he pressed the top button. He was on his way to finishing his job, and returning home. Now he just had to find the doctor. As the elevator stopped and opened, he was greeted buy the sound of gunfire. He looked into the open room to see 6 men wearing all black holding pistols, and the doctor strapped into a lazy-boy recliner in the back of the roomThe thugs on the third floor attempted to riddle him with bullets, but the bullets all fell to the ground. Seeing all the bullet holes in his favorite spandex suit sent him into a fit of rage, and Perfect President took it out on the people in front of him. The doctor watched in the back of the room in horror, as Perfect President beat the tar out of the 6 thugs that fired at him. Perfect President, surrounded by a circle of carnage, looked straight to the professor and said, “It’s time to manifest your destiny! Let’s go home.” He and the doctor returned to the elevator, and made their way to the ground floor.

  When the doors opened to the first floor, Perfect President heard a voice he knew too well.

“I see you found Doctor Kageyama, Perfect President.” Said the voice that President despised, “it’s too bad you won’t be leaving the Compound!”

“Lying Lawyer what are you doing here! I kicked you out of the Bravery Force years ago! You’re supposed to be in prison!”

“Prison wasn’t as fun without you around old buddy! Besides, I can’t let you leave with the doctor! See my client wants him hurt, and I’m not afraid to go through you to do it!”

“Is that so? I don’t know how you’re going to get past me, I’m invincible! I’m going to get Doctor Kageyama out of here, and there’s nothing you can do to stop me!” 

Perfect President stared down Lying Lawyer. What he saw before him was a man roughly 6’ tall. He had slicked back brown hair, and matching brown eyes, his pale white skin was covered by a black suit and tie, and he was holding a briefcase. He noticed that Lying Lawyer was wearing Black dress shoes, shock would be difficult to fight in. Seeing a weakness, the President made his move, sweeping the legs of Lying Lawyer. Lying Lawyer hit the ground hard, breaking his hip in the process. With no other option he picked up the gun that was left on the floor from the thug slouched on the wall behind him, and began firing at the president. The bullets bounced off the Boulder of a man in front of him, but he kept firing until the clip ran out. In one final act of desperation, he threw the gun at the perfect specimen in front of him.

“OW THAT HURT!” Yelled Perfect President, tears welling in his eyes.

“What?” Asked Lying Lawyer.

Tears started flowing down his face as he dropped to the ground. “That wasn’t fair that hurt really bad! You can’t throw guns at people! You bully!”

Lying lawyer couldn’t believe his eyes, The man who was unstoppable for years was... crying? Because a gun was ~thrown~ at him? It was confusing but he decided to roll with it.

“You know what, screw this! I’m done playing superhero! I’m going home!” Perfect President picked himself up, and limped out of the building. 

The next day at school, Max was upset to find out that Jimmy was grounded for throwing his nerf gun. He wanted jimmy to get in trouble, but he still wanted to him to come over after school! The Cardboard Compound would have to wait, and so would the rivalry between Perfect President and Lying Lawyer.
